activity.role: Novelist and author of Don Quixote
activity.notes: Spanish Monarchy literary-activity envelope bounded by the published Don Quixote first part (Madrid, 1605) and second part (Madrid, 1615). This is authorial activity in historical Spain, not rule over the modern constitutional Spanish state or a fabricated sovereign intellectual government. Military role at Lepanto (1571), Algiers captivity and minor administrative employments are biographical details rather than independent high-impact timeline bands.
